name: Multi-Tenant WhatsApp AI Agent
description: One reusable WhatsApp support agent deployable per client. Resolves which business owns the inbound number, loads that client's own knowledge text and system prompt from Supabase, answers strictly from it via Claude with per-conversation memory, and replies on WhatsApp — never inventing details outside the client's knowledge doc.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Message Received
nodes.notes: Requires a WhatsApp Business Cloud API credential

nodes.name: Normalize Input
nodes.notes: Extracts waId, messageText, contactName, phoneNumberId from the inbound webhook payload

nodes.name: Lookup Client by Phone Number
nodes.notes: Requires a Supabase credential. Expects a 'clients' table with columns: phone_number_id, business_name, system_prompt, knowledge_doc

nodes.name: Build Session Context
nodes.notes: Builds a per-client, per-contact sessionKey ({clientId}_{waId}) for conversation memory

nodes.name: WhatsApp Support Agent
nodes.notes: System prompt is built from the client's own system_prompt + knowledgeDoc. Instructed to say so honestly and offer human handoff if the answer isn't covered, never invent details, and keep replies short/plain-text for WhatsApp

meta.setup_notes: Requires: a WhatsApp Business Cloud API credential, a Supabase credential with a 'clients' table (phone_number_id, business_name, system_prompt, knowledge_doc), and an Anthropic API credential. Each row in 'clients' is one tenant — add a new row to onboard a new business, no workflow changes needed. Replace all YOUR_* placeholders before use.
